Rádio Nacional Amazônia FAQ

What frequency is Rádio Nacional Amazônia on?
In the A-26 season Rádio Nacional Amazônia is scheduled on 4 shortwave frequencies, including 6180, 11780, 15145, 15150 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 6180 kHz (8 pm – 11 pm Eastern). For Europe: 6180 kHz (7:25 am – 3:07 am UTC+1).

Can I hear Rádio Nacional Amazônia in the USA?
It isn't beamed at North America this season, so hearing it in the USA is a DX catch. Your best chance is 6180 kHz (8 pm – 11 pm Eastern) when that band is open, or listen through an online receiver (KiwiSDR/WebSDR) closer to its target area.

Does Rádio Nacional Amazônia broadcast in English on shortwave?
Yes. English broadcasts this season: 6180 kHz at 01:50–01:55 UTC to Brazil; 6180 kHz at 07:50–07:55 UTC to Brazil; 6180 kHz at 10:20–10:25 UTC to Brazil; 11780 kHz at 01:50–01:55 UTC to Brazil; 11780 kHz at 07:50–07:55 UTC to Brazil; plus 3 more.

Is Rádio Nacional Amazônia on the air right now?
